_comment: Sample acceptance-environment test data. Spec terminology: cashout = collection (money OUT of customer wallet), cashin = disbursement (money INTO recipient wallet). Copy this file to smoke-test.json and fill in baseUrl, publicKey, secretKey. Set any block to null (or remove it) to skip the corresponding scenario.
_collect_comment: By default every collection scenario stops at the quote — the harness never calls /v2/collectstd. To exercise a real collect on a given flow, add the following keys to that block: "collect": true, "customerPhonenumber": "<payer/recipient MSISDN>", "customerEmailaddress": "<receipt email>". For services with isReqServiceNumber=true (e.g. CMMTNMOMO Cash-In), also set "serviceNumber". Other optional pass-through fields: customerName, customerAddress, customerNumber, trid (auto-generated otherwise), tag, callbackUrl, cdata. WARNING: opting in moves real money on the partner balance.

_collect_example._comment: Worked example — copy these keys into the cashin block to disburse 1000 XAF to MSISDN 699999999 via CMORANGEMOMO.

cashout._comment: Collection — money flows OUT of customer wallet. Sample: CMMTNMOMO Cash-Out / Depot, serviceId 20053, MSISDN 677389120.

bill._comment: SEARCHABLE_BILL. Sample: ENEO postpaid contract 203157530. Other options to try: CAMWATER (serviceId 990007 / 010178181220101), CMDGI (202302 / 43011666543), CMDOUANES (202303 / CMDP32023GEN017240I).

topup._comment: TOPUP airtime. Sample: CMMTN serviceId 20051, MSISDN 677389120. Other options: CMORANGE (20062 / 697707102), CMCamtel (20101 / 242349577).

_voucher_comment: If the partner environment exposes a VOUCHER-type service without a published serviceId, run the smoke test once and look up the VOUCHER entry in the 'Service catalog' output (line: '- VOUCHER: N') by inspecting client.masterdata().services() entries with type=VOUCHER, then replace the null above with { "serviceId": <that id> }.

product._comment: PRODUCT. Sample: CanalPlus Canal+ decoder serviceId 90006. Other options: CMStarTimes (20021), NGDSTV (202301), CMEASYTV (91006).

subscription._comment: SUBSCRIPTION. Sample: CMSABC SABC Subscription serviceId 5000. Try serviceNumber 0000000101 first; if 'no subscriptions for…' fall back to 00000108, or to serviceId 10041 / ref 357-1029517-8 (look up that service's merchant via services()).

cashin._comment: Disbursement — money flows INTO recipient wallet. Sample: CMMTNMOMO Cash-In / Retrait, serviceId 20052, MSISDN 677389120. Other options: CMORANGEOM Cash-In (30052 / 697707102), CMYOOMEEMONEY Cashin (100237 / 242254751).

verify._comment: Pre-payment serviceNumber validation. Sample: ENEO postpaid contract 203157530 (verifiable contract).

validate._comment: Account validation via GET /v2/validate — returns a CustomerAccount {status, name, destination}. Status: UNKNOWN | VALIDATED (syntax only) | VERIFIED (cross-checked with provider). Sample: MTN MoMo MSISDN 677389120 against the cashout service 20053. Swap destination/serviceId for the account you want to validate.
